title: Trump Envoys Arrive in Moscow for Talks on Ukraine War
summary_full: Steve Witkoff, President Trump’s special envoy, and Jared Kushner, his son-in-law, plan to visit Kyiv next, in an effort to revive peace negotiations between Russia and Ukraine.
